description: "Use when creating or updating non-code documentation, README files, tester notes, release notes, handover notes, architecture notes, changelogs, or build distribution notes."
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# READMEFIRST Documentation

Use `.github/skills/readmefirst/SKILL.md` before creating or moving non-code documents.

Project documentation belongs in `READMEFIRST/`:

- Keep the root `README.md` short and point to `READMEFIRST/` for detailed notes.
- Do not scatter loose markdown files in the repo root.
- Edit existing notes in place instead of appending corrections at the bottom.
- State what is not done, what was verified, and where build artifacts live.
- Keep checksums, links, filenames, and tester instructions accurate.
